The Kanchipuram silk saree is one of the: Iyo Kanchipuram silk saree ndeimwe yeanonyanya kufarirwa echinyakare machira eTamil Nadu. Saree inorukwa neshinda yesiririka, ine goridhe- kana sirivheri-shinda dzezari dzichiwedzera hupfumi hwekushongedza. Kanchipuram silk sarees inobata nzvimbo yakakosha mumichato yeTamil, mhemberero dzechitendero, mitambo, uye dzimwe nguva dzinokosha. Iyo craft yakagadzirwa kwezvizvarwa, uye iro chairo gore rekutanga harina kunyorwa nhoroondo. Kancheepuram Silk yakagamuchira kuzivikanwa kweGeographical Indication (GI) muna 2005. Nhasi, saree inomiririra nhaka yeTamil Nadu yemucheka, unyanzvi hwemhizha, uye kuenderera mberi kwehupenyu hwemagariro evanhu vanoruka.
The Kandangi saree is a traditional cott: Kandangi saree ichirairo chedonje chinosanganiswa nedunhu reChettinad, kunyanya Karaikudi nenzvimbo dzakavakidzana. Inozivikanwa nekuda kwecheki yayo yakashinga, mitsetse, miganhu inosiyanisa, uye mavara akasimba, anosanganisira tsvuku, masitadhi, orenji, uye yevhu brown. Nechinyakare, jira rayo rakasimba rekotoni rakanga rakakodzera kushandiswa nguva dzose, richiratidza zvinodiwa zvezvipfeko zvezuva nezuva. Kandangi weaving inomiririra yakasarudzika aesthetic uye machira ruzivo rwedunhu reChettinad. Maitiro ayo uye musanganiswa wemavara anoisiyanisa kubva kune dzimwe dzakawanda dzeSouth Indian saree tsika. Maitiro ekugadzira anosanganisira kugadzirira shinda, kuronga shinda pachirukwa, kuruka jira, nekuzadza miganhu nekupedza. Zvinyorwa zvehurumende zvemaoko zvinotsanangura tsika iyi seyakagara kwemakore anopfuura 150, kunyange zvazvo gore rayo rekutanga risati ranyatsozivikanwa. Kandangi sarees vakagamuchira GI kuzivikanwa muna 2019, vachibatsira kuziva nekuchengetedza kuzivikanwa kwavo kwedunhu uye hunyanzvi hwechinyakare.

Muto wepalm waigona kudyiwa uchangoburwa kana kugadzikiswa, nepo shuga yemichindwe uye jaggery yemuchindwe zvaishandiswa sezvinotapira. Zvigadzirwa zvemichindwe zvainyanya kukosha munzvimbo umo muti wacho waive wakawanda uye wakaumba chikamu chekurarama kwenzvimbo.
The pambai is a pair of drums played tog: The pambai zvigubhu zviviri zvinoridzwa pamwechete, manzwi azvo akasiyana uye epamusoro achityaira mitambo yevanhu, midungwe nemitambo yemumusha muTamil Nadu. Tsika yaro yekurarama yakanyorwa zvirinani pane kwayakabva, uye repertoire yayo inoshanduka kubva mudunhu kuenda kudunhu uye munharaunda kuenda munharaunda.
The Pancha Rathas are monolithic shrines: Iyo Pancha Rathas ndeye monolithic shrines imwe neimwe yakavezwa kubva kune imwechete kunze, ichiratidza huwandu hwematemberi ekuvaka mafomu mumatombo.
The Pandya capital on the Vaigai, closel: Guta rePandya paVaigai, rakanyatso kusungirirwa kune tsika dzeTamil Sangam uye nhetembo dzechinyakare.
The Pandyas: Temples from the Living Roc: The Pandyas: Temberi kubva kuLiving Rock
The parai is a Tamil frame drum: a circu: Iyo parai ingoma yechiTamil frame: furemu yedenderedzwa ine membrane yakatambanudzwa, inorohwa nemabhiabhi mumitambo ine mapeteni. Yagara ichishandira zviziviso, tsika, mitambo nemariro, uye parai attam yanhasi inobatana nekuridza ngoma kutamba. Nhoroondo yaro zvakare inotakura hutungamiri hwemhando iyo yaizvidza vatambi vazhinji venhaka - uye netsika yechiTamil nhasi parai inoridzwa kuratidza kuzivikanwa, chiremerera uye kuenzana.
The Periplus of the Erythraean Sea names: Periplus yeGungwa reErythraean inodana Tyndis pakati pezviteshi zvemhenderekedzo yegungwa yokumadokero, munzvimbo yamambo Chera, uye mabhuku echiTamil anoyeuka chiteshi chengarava chinonzi Tondi. Payakamira hapana chokwadi: Tanur, Ponnani neKadalundi zvese zvakatsanangurwa, uye dhorobha remazuvano reThondi riri pamhenderekedzo yegungwa yeTamil Nadu yekumaodzanyemba-kumabvazuva haingozivikanwe nerevo yekare. Tyndis inonzwisiswa zvakanyanya nenzvimbo yayo pakati pezviteshi zveMalabar uye nzira dzemukati kumashure kwavo.
The ports and trading centres of ancient: Zviteshi nenzvimbo dzekutengesa dzekare dzeTalikam - Puhar neArikamedu kumhenderekedzo yekumabvazuva, Korkai neAlagankulam munyika yePandya, Muziris neTyndis kumadokero, uye Uraiyur, Karur neKodumanal mukati menyika - imwe neimwe mubhuku remifananidzo rekuchera kwayo.
The pullanguzhal, the bamboo flute, is b: Pullanguzhal, nyere yemushenjere, inoridzwa nepaburi apa zvigunwe zvichivhara nekufukunura maburi ayo. Munhetembo yeSangam nyere ndeyamullai, nzvimbo yevafudzi nemasango; nhasi inonzwika mumhanzi wevanhu, wekunamata uye weclassical zvakafanana. Nhetembo 'nyere yehufundisi idingindira rekunyora, asi-kwete humbowo hwekuti nyere dzese dzekare chaive chiridzwa chimwe chete.
The red arrow is you, pointing where you: Museve mutsvuku ndiwe, unongedza pauri kutarisa.
The region’s archaeological evidence, li: Humbowo hwekuchera matongo hwedunhu, zvinyorwa, nzvimbo yemahombekombe uye zviratidziro zvetsika zvinobatsira vashanyi kunzwisisa kukosha kwayo kwenhoroondo.
The reverse of a coin naming Uttama Chol: Reverse remari inonzi Uttama Chola (c. 970–985 CE), ane mari yesirivha iri pakati penyaya dzekutanga dzeChola kutakura zita ramambo - pano mugwaro reGrantha rinoshandiswa kuSanskrit munyika yeTamil.
The reverse of a Setu coin, where the le: Reverse remari yeSetu, pakanyorwa ngano yekuti “Setu”. Kuverenga zvakanyorwa pazviso zvese zvemari - iyo yakashata uye yakadzokera kumashure - ndiyo nzira iyo vanusmatist vanozivisa kuti ndiani akazviburitsa uye rinhi.
The revived Pandya kingdom continued to: Humambo hwePandya hwakamutsiridzwa hwakaramba huchishandisa chiratidzo chehove, kazhinji kuratidza peya yehove, dzimwe nguva netsvimbo kana mwenje.
The ripe paddy is cut by hand with sickl: Mucheka wakaibva unochekwa nemaoko nemajeko, wopurwa kuti zviparadzanise zviyo nemadzinde uye kuurutsa kuti hundi hubve. Kukohwa kwakadyisa dzimba nemisika, uye mari yeminda kubva kwairi yakatsigira masimba ekutonga - kurima kwaitsigira kupfuya mombe, kugadzira zviyo, kutakura uye kutengeserana pamwe chete nazvo.
The river that fed the Chola kingdom’s a: Rwizi rwakadyisa kurima kweumambo hweChola uye nhetembo dzayo dzekuwanda.
The rock-cut and structural monuments of: Iwo matombo-akachekwa uye akaumbwa zviyeuchidzo zveMamallapuram akavezwa pasi pePallavas, kusanganisira iyo huru yekuzorodza uye mashanu Rathas.
The rock-cut caves, sculptural reliefs,: Mapako ematombo-akachekwa, sculptural reliefs, monolithic rathas uye temberi dzakavakwa zvinopa humbowo hwakananga hwePallava hunyanzvi hwekubudirira.
The Salem silk saree is associated with: Iyo Salem silk saree inosanganiswa neSalem, inzvimbo yakakosha inogadzira machira muTamil Nadu. Yakarukwa ichishandisa shinda yesiririka, masari aya anouya nemavara akasiyana, magadzirirwo emuganho, uye mapatani ekushongedza. Chitarisiko chavo chinogona kubva kune akareruka uye anoyevedza dhizaini kune mamwe machira akakwenenzverwa akagadzirirwa michato, mitambo, uye zvimwe zviitiko zvakakosha. Salem's textile heritage yakabatana nekukura kwakakura kwekugadzirwa kwesirika, kuruka, uye misika yemisika yemachira muTamil Nadu. Chigadzirwa chacho chinoda basa reunyanzvi pakugadzira shinda, kugadzira chirukwa, kuchengetedza kurukana kusingachinji, uye kupedza jira. Salem Silk yakagamuchira GI kuzivikanwa muna 2007, ichibvuma zviri pamutemo kuzivikanwa kwayo kwedunhu. Zuva rekunyoresa iri hariratidzi kuti tsika iyi yakatanga rini. Nhasi, sirika yeSalem inoramba iri chikamu chenhaka yeTamil Nadu yakasiyana-siyana yemachira uye inoratidza kukosha kwenzvimbo dzekuruka dzedunhu mukuchengetedza hunyanzvi hwechinyakare uye kutsigira raramo yemhizha.

The same notes on Rajendra Chola I, in T: Zvinyorwa zvakafanana paRajendra Chola I, muTamil.

Iwo manotsi akafanana paTamil chikafu, muchiTamil.

The same notes on the Seven Great Patron: Iwo manotsi mamwe chete paVanomwe Vakuru Vatendi veTamil tsika, muchiTamil.
Manotsi mamwe chete paVel Pari, muTamil.
The saree traditions of Tamil Nadu — the: Tsika dzeSaree dzeTamil Nadu - masiriki eKanchipuram, Arani, Thirubuvanam naSalem, donje rakasungirirwa reMadurai Sungudi, Kovai Kora donje, cheki dzakashinga dzeChettinad Kandangi, uye saree dzemuchato dzeKoorainadu - imwe neimwe mubhuku remifananidzo.
The sea and the shore, at dusk in every: Gungwa negungwa, panguva yorubvunzavaeni, panguva ipi neipi. Mwari waro ndiVarunan, ishe wemvura, uye ruva rayo bhuruu mvura-ruva (neithal). Dingindira rayo ndere irangal - kunetseka kupenya sezvo gamba rinotarisa gungwa rechikepe chemudiwa wake. Vanhu varo vanobata hove, voomesa hove dzavo uye vogadzira munyu mumapani egungwa.
The sea routes that joined the Tamil coa: Nzira dzegungwa dzakabatana negungwa reTamil kuGungwa Dzvuku, Mediterranean uye South-East Asia, mavakirwo ezviteshi - wharves, matsime uye zvidhinha quays - uye zvirongo, ivhu uye zvinhu zvakafamba pakati pavo - neAdichanallur, Iron Age ivhu remupata weThamirabarani, mune zvinyoro uye firimu.
The secret of Kallanai’s endurance: clay: Chakavanzika chekutsungirira kwaKallanai: ivhu uye silt yakanaka yakatakurwa nemafashamo yakashanda munzvimbo dziri pakati pematombo ndokudziisa chisimbiso. Rwizi urwu rwakabatsira kuvaka dhamu rarwo, uye mafashamo ose aisiya ivhu idzva aivandudza chidhindo chacho. Netsika ichi chipingamupinyi chedombo-nevhu chakamira murwizi mhenyu kweanoda kusvika zviuru zviviri zvemakore.
The shore at Poompuhar in Mayiladuthurai: Mhenderekedzo paPoompuhar mudunhu reMailaduthurai, uko kushanduka kwemahombekombe uye kukoromoka kwakagadzirisazve mamiriro echiteshi chekare.
The shore at Poompuhar today, near the m: Mhenderekedzo yePoompuhar nhasi, padyo nemuromo weKaveri, paive pakamira chiteshi cheChola chePuhar. Ongororo dzepasi pemvura dzakawana masonry pamhenderekedzo iyi; kuti guta rekare rakasvika kure zvakadini, uye kuti mhenderekedzo yegungwa yakachinja sei, zvichiri kuongororwa.
The Shore Temple and its grounds beside: The Shore Tembere nenzvimbo dzayo dziri padyo negungwa, zvinoonekwa kubva kumusoro.
The Shore Temple in an early painting: The Shore Temple mune yekutanga pendi
The Shore Temple on the Coromandel Coast: Iyo Shore Tembere paCoromandel Coast, chikamu cheBoka reMonuments paMahabalipuram, iyo UNESCO World Heritage Site.
The shortest of the Ten Idylls, by Nappu: Iyo pfupisa yeGumi Idyll, naNapputanar. Yakagara musango (mullai) mamiriro ezvinhu munguva yekunaya kwemvura, inoratidza mudzimai akamirira nemwoyo murefu kuti murume wake adzoke kubva kuhondo.
The signature pottery of the Tamil Iron: Iyo siginicha yehari yeTamil Iron Age ndeye nhema-uye-tsvuku ware: tsvuku kunze, yakasviba yakasviba mukati uye pamupendero. Vaumbi vakazviita nokupfura midziyo yakadzikira pasi, zvokuti chikamu chaidzivirira kubva mumhepo chikabva chasviba. Hari zhinji dzakadai dzinotakura mavanga kana kuti graffiti dzakakweshwa muvhu, uye kubva panguva yekutanga nhoroondo zvichienda mberi, mazita akanyorwa neTamil-Brahmi - manyoro ekare echiTamil - kuKeeladi, Kodumanal, Arikamedu uye kure seSri Lanka, Thailand uye mahombekombe eGungwa Dzvuku kuEgypt.
The surviving halls, pillars, arches and: Dzimba dzakasara, mbiru, arches uye chivanze zvinochengetedza yakakosha mienzaniso yeNayak architecture, kunyangwe iyo yese yekutanga yakaoma isisipo.
The temple complex from above, within th: Imba yetembere kubva kumusoro, mukati meguta razvino reThanjavur.
The temple complex in the modern city: Iyo temberi yakaoma muguta remazuva ano
The temple enclosure from directly above: The temberi yakakomberedzwa kubva zvakananga kumusoro
The temple enclosure seen from directly: Iyo temberi yakavharidzirwa inoonekwa kubva kumusoro zvakananga: iyo vimana, iyo yakareba mandapa, nzvimbo dzinoyera dzakapoteredza chivanze uye shumba yakatenderera-yakatarisana zvakanaka pedyo nemukova.
The temple from the air, its gopurams ri: Temberi kubva kumhepo, gopuram dzayo dzinokwira pamusoro pemigwagwa yeguta remazuva ano iro rakakura rakaipoteredza.
The temple, sculptural details, inscript: Temberi, zvinyorwa zvekuveza, zvinyorwa uye zvakasara zvekuchera matongo zvinochengetedza humbowo hwekukosha kwehumambo uye hwechitendero chenzvimbo.
The temple’s own inscriptions record its: Zvinyorwa zvetemberi pachazvo zvinonyora chivakwa chayo, endowments uye tsvimbo zvakadzama.
The Ten Idylls and the Eight Anthologies: Iwo Gumi Idyll uye Eight Anthologies - yekutanga nhetembo yechiTamil, muCICT editions.
The Thamirabarani — known in Tamil as th: The Thamirabarani - inozivikanwa muchiTamil sePorunai - inoyerera ichipfuura murwi wemakuva ichienda kuGulf of Mannar. Kudzika nerwizi Korkai, chiteshi chengarava chePandya chaizivikanwa nemaparera acho; sezvinotaurwa nefirimu, vanhu vomumupata uyu vaigona kusvika kugungwa, uye nzira dziri mhiri kwaro, nenzira yorwizi. Rwizi rwakapa mupata minda yakaorera, mvura uye mugwagwa unoenda kumahombekombe.
The thavil, closely tied to the Thanjavu: Iyo thavil, yakanyatso kusungirirwa kunharaunda yeThanjavur, idhiramu yakaita sedhiramu rine musoro kumagumo ega ega, inotambwa neruoko rumwe pamusoro mumwe uye kamuti kapfupi pane imwe. Mumubatanidzwa weNadaswaram inoita zvakawanda kupfuura kuchengeta nguva: vatambi vane hunyanzvi vanopindura rwiyo neruzha rwakasiyana uye nesimba, zvine ruzha rwakakwana kufora kwekunze uye kuungana kukuru kwetembere.
The Thirubuvanam silk saree originates f: Thirubuvanam silk saree anobva kuThirubuvanam mudunhu reThanjavur kuTamil Nadu. Inomiririra tsika yekuruka sirika umo nyanzvi dzinogadzira machira esirika ane mavara akashongedzwa nemipendero yakarukwa uye zvechinyakare motif. Zvichienderana nekugadzirwa, sarees inogona kuratidza maitiro akajeka, mavara akasiyana, uye zvinhu zvekushongedza zvakakodzera zvipfeko zvemhemberero uye zvemhemberero. Tsika iyi inoratidza kudyidzana kwenguva refu kwedunhu nehunyanzvi hwemachira uye kufambiswa kweruzivo rwekuruka muzvizvarwa. Kugadzirwa kweSirika saree kunoda hunyanzvi mukugadzira shinda, mashandiro ekuruka, magadzirirwo epateni, uye kupera kwejira. Kunyangwe iro gore chairo rekutanga risati rasimbiswa, Thirubuvanam inoramba iri zita rakakosha redunhu muTamil Nadu's silk-weaving nhaka. Saree dzayo dzinoratidza kuti nzvimbo dzakasiyana dzekuruka dzakagadzira sei masitaera uye nemukurumbira wakasiyana zvichibatsira munhoroondo yakakura yemachira ekuSouth Indian.
The Thirukkural by Thiruvalluvar: 1,330: The Thirukkural by Thiruvalluvar: 1,330 mitsara miviri miviri muchitsauko 133, yakakamurwa kuva mabhuku matatu - Virtue (Aram), Pfuma (Porul), uye Rudo (Inbam). Yakashandurirwa mumitauro yakawanda yenyika.
The Thirukkural could not be opened just: Iyo Thirukkural haina kukwanisa kuvhurwa izvozvi. Ndapota vhara mupumburu woedza zvakare.
The three crowned kings of the Tamil lan: Madzimambo matatu akagadzwa korona enyika yeTamil mumwe nomumwe akanga ane chiratidzo, uye mari yavo inotakura: dindingwe ravaCholas, hove dzePandyas, uye uta hwaChera. Verengai pamwe chete, zviratidzo izvi zvinotaurira nhoroondo yezvematongerwo enyika - kana mari yeChola ikaratidza ingwe yakakomberedzwa nehove yePandya uye Chera uta, inozivisa kutonga kwamambo weChola pamusoro pevakwikwidzi vake.
The Tirukkural contains 1,330 couplets a: The Tirukkural ine 1,330 couplets akarongwa kuva 133 zvitsauko. Yakakamurwa kuita zvikamu zvitatu: Kunaka, Pfuma uye Rudo. Basa rinokurukura maitiro emunhu, hupenyu hwemhuri, ushamwari, dzidzo, utongi, kururamisira uye tsitsi.
The Tirukkural has been translated into: Iyo Tirukkural yakashandurirwa mumitauro yakawanda, zvichibvumira mazano aThiruvalluvar kuti asvike kuvaverengi kupfuura miganhu yezvinyorwa zveTamil.
The Tiruvalangadu plates of Rajendra I a: Mahwendefa eTiruvalangadu aRajendra I uye mahwendefa eAnbil eSundara Chola ndiwo makuru ezvinyorwa zvedzinza uye nhoroondo yedzinza reChola.
The Tolkappiyam by Tolkappiyar is the ol: Iyo Tolkappiyam naTolkappiyar ndiyo yekare girama yechiTamil yasara. Mabhuku aro matatu anofukidza mavara nemanzwi (Ezhuthu), mazwi (Sol), uye nyaya yehupenyu uye nhetembo (Porul).
The udukkai is a small hourglass-shaped: Udukkai kangoma kadiki kakaita sehourglass, misoro yayo miviri yakabatanidzwa netambo dzetension; kudzvinya tambo kunogona kuchinja namo. Yakabatwa nerumwe ruoko uye ichirohwa nerumwe, inoperekedza nziyo dzekunamata, nganonyorwa dzechivanhu uye mitambo yetsika - chiyeuchidzo chekuti kurovana, kuzvipira uye kuita zvemuromo zvakabatanidzwa sei.
The ural and ulakkai were used to pound: Ural uye ulakkai zvaishandiswa kupura mupunga, mapfunde, zviyo nezvinonhuwira. Mushonga wacho waiva ngarava yakasimba, yaiwanzogadzirwa nematanda kana kuti dombo, nepo ulakkai yaiva mudziyo wakareba wokurovera nawo. Pamwe chete, vakabatsira kubvisa husk, kuputsa zviyo uye kugadzira zvinhu zvekubikira. Zvishandiso zvinoratidzawo kushanda nesimba uye basa rekugoverana rinobatanidzwa mukugadzirira kwechinyakare chikafu.
The veenai (Saraswati veena) is one of t: The veenai (Saraswati veena) chimwe chezviridzwa zvakakosha zveSouth Indian classical music: resonator hombe yemapuranga, mutsipa wakarebesa, tambo uye mapegi ekugadzirisa, kazhinji ane resonator yechipiri. Kudzvanya uye kutsvedza tambo kurwisa frets kunopa mumhanzi weCarnatic zvishongo zvayo zvakanaka. Yakabatana naSaraswati, mwarikadzi wekudzidza, inofanira kusiyaniswa kubva kune yekare yazh - yakafanana mubasa, asi kwete chizvarwa chayo chakananga.
The walls of the Brihadeeswarar temple c: Masvingo etemberi yeBrihadeeswarar anotakura zvinyorwa zvirefu zveRajaraja I zvichinyora endowments, tsvimbo yetemberi, matombo anokosha, uye zvipo - rekodhi inoshamisa yetemberi senzvimbo.
The wooden plough, often drawn by cattle: Gejo remuti, raiwanzodhonzwa nemombe kana kuti nyati, raishandiswa kusunungura uye kugadzira munda wekurima. Nematurusi emawoko ekudyara nekusakura, majeko ekukohwa, nekupura nekuurusa kuti achenese zviyo, zvaive zvezvishandiso izvo nharaunda dzevarimi dzakajairana nevhu radzo nezvirimwa uye dzichibva kune chimwe chizvarwa kuenda kune chimwe.
The woodland and pastures, in the evenin: Sango namafuro madekwana emwaka wokunaya kwemvura. Mwari waro ndiMayon (Thirumal), uye ruva rayo jasmine (mullai). Dingindira rayo iruthal - kumirira nemoyo murefu, sezvo heroine inomirira kuti murume wake adzoke mvura isati yanaya. Vanhu varo vafudzi vanofudza mombe uye vanozora ruomba nebhata.
The works that arrange their verses land: Mabasa anoronga mavhesi adzo anoenderana nemamiriro ezvinhu — Ainkurunuru, Aintinai Aimpathu naEzhupathu, Tinaimozhi Aimpathu, Tinaimalai Nurraimpathu naKainnilai — mumasumbu emashizha emichindwe umo vakakopwa.
The world-famous Chola bronzes: how they: Iyo inozivikanwa pasi rose Chola bronzes: magadzirirwo akaitwa neyakarasika-wax nzira, iyo Nataraja mufananidzo, uye mhenyu hunyanzvi hweSwamimalai.
The yazh is one of the most distinctive: Iyo yazh ndechimwe chezviridzwa zvakasarudzika zvechiTamil zvinyorwa zvekare: chiridzwa chetambo chakabvutwa, chakafara kunge rudimbwa. Sangam inoshanda sePerumpanatrupadai, uye Silappatakaram, inotsanangura, uye ndeyepanar, mabhadhi akabatana nenhetembo kumimhanzi. Nyanzvi dzinotumidza mafomu akati wandei - iyo periyazh, siriyazh, sakota yazh uye vil yazh - iyo chaiyo mavakirwo ayo zvinyorwa hazviratidzi zvizere, saka chero yazh inoonekwa nhasi ndeyekuvakazve. Icho chiridzwa pachacho, kwete kungoita veenai yekutanga.
These are food traditions associated wit: Idzi ndidzo tsika dzechikafu dzakabatana nenzvimbo uye nharaunda dzeSangam zvinyorwa, kwete mamenu akasarudzika anoteverwa nemunhu wese. Zvaidyiwa nevanhu zvaisiyana nenguva, nharaunda, mwaka uye kutengeserana. Iwo mafoto magadzirirwo emazuva ano ezvekudya zvinotsanangurwa nemagwaro, kwete madhishi ekare.
Thirugnanasambandar, the 7th-century chi: Thirugnanasambandar, mwana-musande wezana ramakore rechinomwe, mumwe wevakuru Shaiva Nayanmars ane nziyo dzinovhura Tevaram. Chola bronzes inomuratidza semukomana mudiki achitamba mukufara, chigunwe chake che index chakasimudzwa chakanangana naShiva, uyo - nyaya inoenda - akange amupa mukaka wehungwaru kubva pazamu raParvati.
Thirumalai Nayak Palace represents the a: Thirumalai Nayak Palace inomiririra kubwinya kwekuvaka, tsika yehumambo uye nhoroondo yezvematongerwo enyika yeMadurai Nayak nguva.
Thirumalai Nayak Palace was constructed: Thirumalai Nayak Palace yakavakwa muzana remakore rechigumi nemanomwe panguva yekutonga kwaMambo Thirumalai Nayak weMadurai Nayak Dynasty. Imba yamambo yakashanda senzvimbo yekugara yamambo uye musimboti wehupenyu hwedare.
